name: htmlgames
description: A collection of browser-based games built with HTML5, CSS, and JavaScript. This project serves as a playground for experimenting with game development using standard web technologies.

scripts.test:build: playwright test && echo '✅ All tests passed!'
scripts.build: npm run test:build && npx cap sync && cd android && export JAVA_HOME=$(/usr/libexec/java_home -v 21) && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.deploy: npm run build && ~/Library/Android/sdk/platform-tools/adb -s R3CT50BYRVY install -r android/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk && ~/Library/Android/sdk/platform-tools/adb -s R3CT50BYRVY shell am start -n com.example.htmlgames/.MainActivity
